description: List account accesses (users, invites, API tokens) for the account. Optionally scope by domain UUIDs, inbox IDs, or project IDs. Requires account admin/owner permissions.

domain_uuids.description: Optional: filter by sending domain UUIDs.

inbox_ids.description: Optional: filter by sandbox inbox IDs.

project_ids.description: Optional: filter by sandbox project IDs.

name: list-account-accesses
